Allotted Courses Directory

The Faculty of Skill Development, in partnership with industry bodies like IL&FS Skills and Gujarat Apollo Industries, offers placement-linked, industry-aligned training programs under the National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF), ranging from certificate courses to B.Voc degrees.
